name: strategy-council
description: The brainstorming council — the front-door brain of the Strategy and Research Team (Atlas). A guided strategic conversation that pressure-tests a topic, offer, class idea, or campaign from multiple voices, proposes alternatives, and converges to a sharpened angle with the dissent + a research mandate. Use for /atlas-think, "brainstorm this", "help me think this through", "should we make X", "is this a good angle", "pressure-test this idea", "what angle".
